svg.title: A redundant network connecting a Sender and a Receiver through ten intermediate nodes
svg.desc: A computer network drawn as a graph on a black background. A magenta Sender node at the top and a magenta Receiver node at the bottom are connected through ten blue intermediate nodes, called A through J here, joined by green links. The links are: Sender–A; Sender–B; Sender–D; A–D; A–E; B–C; B–F; B–H; C–D; D–G; D–H; E–J; F–H; F–I; G–J; H–I; H–J; H–Receiver; I–Receiver. There are multiple routes between the Sender and the Receiver, so the network can keep working even when some nodes fail.
